newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks retreat in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks retreat in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped into negative territory in early morning trade on Tuesday after opening marginally higher, as profit-taking emerged after the key index posted solid gains on the previous day, brokers said.
By 0016 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average had lost 65.00 points or 0.32 percent to trade at 20,163.72. Its September futures slipped 40 points to 20,200.
"It doesn't mean that the momentum is changing, but people seem to be taking profits for now after yesterday's gains," said a broker at a major securities house.
